spans.s: + भूमि सिद्ध- + भूमि, f. the country in which the Siddhas live, Pañc. 242, 5.
+ यात्रिक सिद्ध- + यात्रिक, m. a pilgrim who seeks for the territory of the Siddhas, Pañc. 240, 16; cf. 242, 5.

+ रस सिद्ध- + रस,
 I. adj. mineral, metallic.
 II. m. 1. quicksilver. 2. an alchymist.
+ लाभ सिद्धि- + लाभ, m. acquirement of success, i. e. applause, Daśak. in
+ संकल्प सिद्ध- + संकल्प, adj. one who has obtained his wishes, Daśak. in

+ साधन सिद्ध- + साधन,
 I. m. white mustard.
 II. n. 1. the performance of magical rites. 2. the materials employed in magical or alchemical processes.
सिद्धान्त, i. e. सिद्ध-अन्त, m. Demonstrated conclusion, established truth, reliable doctrine; doctrine,

सिद्धार्थ, i. e. सिद्ध-अर्थ,
 I. adj. One who has obtained his aim,

; successful.
 II. m. White mustard, Pañc. 158, 3.
 --Comp.

सिद्धि, i. e. सिध् + ति, f.
 1. Accomplishment, Vedāntas. in

; Hit. ii. d. 13; fulfilment, Vikr. d. 28 (read अभिमुखिष्विव, in the ed. [] of Bollens).
 2. Success, Böhtl. Ind.

; prosperity, well-being, Pañc. i. d. 432.
 3. Use, Pañc. ii. d. 93 (न सिद्ध्यै, useless).
 4. Final emancipation, supreme felicity,

. The fruit of the adoration of the gods or of ascetic austerities.
 6. The acquisition of supernatural powers by magical means, magical power, Pañc. 241, 3.
 7. A magical shoe, which is supposed to convey the bearer wherever he likes.
 8. A medicinal root.
 9. Indisputable conclusion, decision, Pañc. iii. d. 91.
